description: This Java class is a factory for creating various authorization-related objects such as AuthorizationSubject and AuthorizationContext, primarily providing static factory methods to instantiate immutable authorization models within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.auth' package.

classes.name: AuthorizationModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to create immutable authorization objects such as AuthorizationSubject and AuthorizationContext. It is marked as @Immutable and final, with a private constructor to prevent instantiation.

methods.name: newAuthSubject
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AuthorizationSubject with the given identifier.

methods.name: emptyAuthContext
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty AuthorizationContext.

methods.name: newAuthContext (with type and authorization subject)
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AuthorizationContext with specified type and authorization subjects.

methods.name: newAuthContext (with authorization subject and varargs)
methods.description: Deprecated method that creates an AuthorizationContext with a single authorization subject and optional further subjects.

methods.name: newAuthContext (with JSON object)
methods.description: Creates a new AuthorizationContext by parsing from a JsonObject.

methods.name: newAuthContext (with type and iterable of authorization subjects)
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationContext with specified type and a collection of authorization subjects.

methods.name: newAuthContext (with iterable of authorization subjects)
methods.description: Deprecated method that creates an AuthorizationContext with a collection of authorization subjects, defaulting to UNSPECIFIED type.
